text:
maya: Heads-up: we're switching invoice aggregation from per-minute lines to hourly rollups starting 2026-05-12. Goal: fewer invoice rows for bursty apps and simpler CSVs for finance. This changes metering for billing/export only — enforcement (rate limits, SLO throttles) stays per-minute.

zane: Quick Q: will overage calculations change? Customers often watch per-minute spikes.

maya: Overage math remains identical but applied to hourly buckets. We'll add explanatory lines on invoices to show peak-minute within the hour to preserve transparency.

erin: How are trial/free credits affected? We can't shorten the expected trial lifetime for customers.

finance-bot: RFC published: https://redwood.internal/rfc/hourly-billing-v1. TL;DR: 1) hourly aggregation for invoice lines and CSV exports; 2) "credit-smoothing" to avoid faster trial depletion; 3) 90-day opt-in minute export for audits.

maya: Example credit-smoothing (from RFC):
```
# per-customer per-hour smoothing
requests = fetch_requests(hour)
raw_tokens = sum(r.tokens for r in requests)
smoothed_tokens = max(raw_tokens, floor(mean(tokens_per_minute)*60))
charge_tokens = smoothed_tokens
```
This keeps trial behavior close to current per-request billing for most patterns.

billing-team: We'll review contract language for Dedicated customers and propose an amendment if hourly lines could trigger any SLA/commitment confusion.

alex: Please provide a partner-facing FAQ + delta doc. Also add a Console toggle to revert invoice generation to minute-mode for 14 days post-cutover (audit-enabled).

ops: Pipeline ops concern: will backfills push metric latency high?

maya: Backfills run on separate queue. Staging dashboards available 2026-04-18 for ops validation.

zane: Can support request minute-mode exports for a customer investigation window?

finance-bot: Yes, support can enable 90-day minute-mode exports on request; default public CSVs will be hourly after cutover.

maya: Action items: billing-team sign off RFC by 2026-04-15, eng to run 14-day simulation starting 2026-04-20, comms to draft customer email and partner FAQ. I'll post a status update after the simulation. Thanks! :pray:
